mfgFacilities.label: Manufacturing facilities
mfgFacilities.definition: Manufacturing facilities operated by the Company's subsidiaries, by major geographic area (64 worldwide). Excludes office and warehouse facilities and contract manufacturers.

employees.definition: Individuals working full-time or part-time, excluding fixed-term employees, interns and co-ops; contingent workers, contractors and subcontractors excluded; total 137,925 in 2024.

notes: J&J publishes no state or country breakdown. Regions come from two sources on different bases: (1) the FY2024 10-K Item 2 manufacturing-facility counts by major geographic area (U.S. 23, Europe 21, Western Hemisphere ex-U.S. 7, Africa/Asia/Pacific 13; total 64); (2) the 2025 Health for Humanity Report performance-data tables, using the 2024 column, for employees by region (total 137,925) and supplier spend contracted by region. The 10-K's own employees-by-region chart is an image with no text values, and the 2024 Health for Humanity Report URLs now redirect to the 2025 edition, so the 2025 edition's prior-year column was used. The HFH regions (Asia Pacific, EMEA, Latin America, North America) and the 10-K regions are differently defined and do not list member countries, so countries is null for every region. The 10-K headcount (139,800 employees; 138,100 FTE) differs from the HFH 137,925 because of definitions and dates.
